subject: Coupa invite: session staleness when accepting portal access
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@turnbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@turnbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Problem accepting Coupa invite (session expired)

Hi Marissa,

We're trying to accept the Coupa supplier invite for TurnBridge but every time we click the link it lands on a page that says 'Session expired' and an error code (ERR_SSN_410). Jennifer and I both tried from different browsers and networks. Screenshot attached (turnbridge-invite-screenshot.png).

Quick details:
- Invite link received: 2026-10-31 17:06 PST
- Error shows when we click "Accept invitation" and after entering organization details it times out immediately.
- Browser: Chrome 118 on macOS; also tried Edge on Windows 10.

We need to get this vendor account activated so PO routing can start — we have a pending PO in Coupa (PO #TB-9981). Can you advise next steps or resend?

Thanks,
Liam
Vendor Onboarding
TurnBridge Logistics

Attachment: turnbridge-invite-screenshot.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@turnbridge.com>
Cc: Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@turnbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting Coupa invite (session expired)

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and for including the screenshot. Sorry for the friction here, we'll get this sorted.

Immediate plan:
- Ben, Priyom — can you triage the invite token and the Coupa relay? From the logs it looks like the invite token was issued but a session cookie may not be binding to the tenant claim (this causes the "expired" landing page).
- Liam/Jennifer — could you confirm which link you clicked (full URL) and whether you used any private/incognito tabs? A short screen recording would help if quick to produce.

I'll regenerate a new invite while we debug; I'll also open a short internal ticket (REQ-2145) and paste updates there. If the new invite still fails, we'll generate a one-time acceptance code flow as a workaround.

Marissa Cole
Partner Success (Procurement)
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: (will include debug log once Ben/Priyom review)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@turnbridge.com>, Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@turnbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Problem accepting Coupa invite (session expired)

Marissa / team,

Quick diagnostic: I pulled the invite flow logs and here's what I see (summary):
- Invite token TBINV-5577 issued correctly on 2026-10-31T17:06
- When the vendor clicks the link, the frontend routes them to the SSO handshake. The RelayState nonce we set is getting overwritten by a stale cookie on the vendor browser that points at a previous tenant id. That mismatch causes our session validator to mark the flow as "stale/expired" and redirect to the generic error page.

Immediate workaround I pushed:
- Regenerated a fresh invite and toggled the link to run the alternative "one-time code" acceptance flow rather than cookie-bound session flow. Sent new invite (REGEN-12345).
- Also uploaded a short debug file to this thread (redwood-debug-log.txt) showing the RelayState vs tenant ID mismatch.

Longer-term fix (REQ-2145):
- Priyom, we should extend the magic link TTL for external tenants by +10 minutes and add a server-side check that compares the RelayState before cookie binding. I can draft the acceptance criteria.

Liam / Jennifer — please try the new invite link I sent (https://app.coupa.com/invite/verify/REGEN-12345). Use a fresh browser session (no previous Coupa cookies) or the one-time code I attached if the link still errors.

Ben Carter
On-call Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-debug-log.txt

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@turnbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@turnbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting Coupa invite (session expired)

Thanks everyone — confirmed. We used the regenerated link and selected the one-time code option; the vendor onboarding flow completed and we can see TurnBridge under the supplier list. PO routing for TB-9981 is now visible.

Appreciate the quick triage and the longer-term notes — happy to be a tester if you need us to validate the TTL change.

Cheers,
Liam
TurnBridge Logistics

Attachment: regenerated-invite-code.txt
